evals.name: combined-kg-request
evals.prompt: Build a knowledge graph of Faradaic efficiencies for copper catalysts in CO2 electroreduction from the literature. Fields: catalyst, applied potential (V vs RHE), product, Faradaic efficiency. Only open-access papers, and use Claude to screen relevance.
evals.expected_output: Banner; converts the user's four fields faithfully into .scripts/<slug>/kg/schema_draft.json (nothing added); no redundant questions; one consolidated plan; hand-offs: paper-acquisition mode=index then mode=download (access OA,OA+ND, screening claude, wrapper_confirmed=true), then data-curation with the schema path.
expectations: Small banner (<= 4 lines, no block-letter art)
Never names internal skills to the user
The user's fields saved as a schema draft under .scripts/<slug>/kg/ that passes check_schema.py
The draft adds nothing beyond the four fields (at most 8 properties)
No redundant questions (access and screening were given)
Collection hand-off with mode=index, access OA,OA+ND, screening=claude, wrapper_confirmed=true
Graph hand-off to data-curation with the schema path

evals.name: update-existing-topic
evals.prompt: update the mxene-no3 papers with anything new
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing topic; update only; hands off paper-acquisition mode=update for mxene-no3; at most one question; no schema drafted.
expectations: Small banner (<= 4 lines, no block-letter art)
Never names internal skills to the user
Hands off the collection stage with mode=update for mxene-no3

evals.name: topic-only-no-schema
evals.expected_output: Index only: asks how to decide relevance (access types are asked at download time), one consolidated plan, hands off paper-acquisition mode=index; never drafts a schema; never names internal skills.
expectations: Small banner (<= 4 lines, no block-letter art)
Never names internal skills to the user
Asks how to decide relevance (the access-type question may wait until download for an index-only request)
At most 3 questions before the confirmation
Hands off the collection stage with mode=index (no graph hand-off, no schema drafted)
